_meta.notes: Chunk file's flag 'listing label November' VERIFIED and it disagrees with the form: the cover's checked box is 'Seven days before a general election' and the signature date is 10-30-16; the clerk stamped RECEIVED IN OFFICE NOV 01 2016 and the Schedule pages are self-dated 11-1-16, which is where the listing's 'November' comes from. Form governs. The cover's 'Office Sought' and 'District Number' cells are BLANK; the top-row 'Office' cell reads 'COUNTY COUNCIL AT LARGE B' and is what office_sought carries (the 2008-era two-office-box substitution already documented for this corpus) - agrees with the chunk file. Neither amendment box (Yes/No) is ticked, so is_amendment is honestly blank. Candidate street address, phone, fax and email are all black-barred on the cover. EVERY Schedule A page has its whole 'Complete Mailing Address' column black-barred, so donor_city/donor_state are blank on all 65 rows and each row note says 'redacted at source' - never 'left empty by the filer'. Two Schedule A name cells carry a second line of bare digits (p6 G. KENT PETERSON '43', p7 BRUCE BINGHAM '4'); those are street-address fragments that escaped the bar and were discarded at read time. One contribution date is malformed ('10 70 16', Niederhauser p4) and is left BLANK with needs_review=1. A $6,000.00 Reagan Outdoor IN KIND item is booked on BOTH schedules (A p7 marked 'IN KIND' in the Occupation cell, B p11 'ADVERTISING IN KIND'), and both printed grand totals include it - so this filing is NOT a schedule-total-vs-summary-gap case. Both sides carry a delta that is the filer's own page arithmetic (A p5 -10.00, B p8 +100.00); no row was adjusted to close a gate.
